lines.text: The LORD warns the sons of Benjamin to flee Jerusalem because disaster looms from the north.
Shepherds and their flocks pitch tents around Jerusalem, and the attackers plan to strike at noon and then by night.
The LORD of Hosts orders the trees cut down and a siege ramp raised, because the city must be punished.
The people's ears are closed to the LORD's word, and their houses will be turned over to the Egyptians.
From prophet to priest all practice sorcery, and they say peace when there is no peace.
